assets.prompt: Create ONE production game sprite atlas on a genuinely transparent background, wide 2:1 aspect ratio, exactly 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, NO grid lines, labels, lettering or borders. Original luxury fishing arcade for Nantuan club: sophisticated hand-painted semi-realistic 3D marine creatures, detailed fins, luminous scales, gold rim lighting, NOT generic icons or toys. Every sprite centered inside its own equal cell, facing RIGHT, full body, 12% transparent margin, no overlap. Row 1 left to right: slender silver blue sardine; orange white-banded clownfish; teal mackerel with striped back; deep-bodied red snapper. Row 2: muscular navy blue tuna with gold finlets; wide lavender blue manta ray with tail left/head right in slightly overhead side pose; turquoise sailfish with tall sail and pointed snout; fantasy golden Asian arowana with armored scales and red-gold fins. Unmistakably different silhouettes. Clean alpha cutouts, no water, scenery or shadows. Used directly as texture atlas in mobile canvas game.

ONE equipment sprite atlas, genuinely transparent background, exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, wide 3:2. No grid lines, labels, text or borders.
